تناقضت (form VI)
# تَنَاقَضْتُ (tanāqaḍtu) /ta.naː.qadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# تَنَاقَضْتَ (tanāqaḍta) /ta.naː.qadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# تَنَاقَضْتِ (tanāqaḍti) /ta.naː.qadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# تَنَاقَضَتْ (tanāqaḍat) /ta.naː.qa.dˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
